# formatted-text API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Semantic text, toolkit typography and bounded inline Markdown.

## FormattedText

Render toolkit typography with bounded inline Markdown or caller-owned JSX.
`as` defaults to span independently of variant. Native attributes/events and ref reach that root.
Uses the host's Fluent theme and Griffel renderer; no SPFx provider is required.
Valid maxLines applies block clamp layout without changing the tag and wins over truncate/wrap.
Unsafe Markdown links preserve their label; raw HTML and unsupported document syntax stay literal.
Strings in arrays and `React.Fragment` receive Markdown. Use a fragment to group strings with JSX
actions: a wrapper such as `<span>` leaves descendant strings unparsed, even with `markdown={true}`.
Arbitrary JSX remains untouched. Ellipsis needs constrained width and suitable element layout.
Each owned string above 64 KiB UTF-8 falls back literally before parsing. More than 2,000
original AST nodes or depth above 32 (root depth 1) also returns the complete string literally.
Node/depth checks run after parsing and do not bound parser work; see the FormattedText guide.

### Imports

```ts
import { FormattedText } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { FormattedText } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { FormattedText } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/formatted-text';
```

### Use when

- Semantic text needs toolkit typography, bounded inline Markdown or overflow presentation.

### Avoid when

- Use EditableText when the user must edit and serialize rich text.

### Examples

#### Inline Markdown heading

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { FormattedText } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

<FormattedText as="h2" variant="title2" maxLines={2}>
  Read the **updates** in [documentation](./docs).
</FormattedText>;
```

#### Mixed content in a fragment

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { FormattedText } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<FormattedText>
  <React.Fragment>
    {'**Project update** '}
    <button type="button">Open project</button>
    {' *review available*'}
  </React.Fragment>
</FormattedText>
```

### Signatures

```ts
(props: FormattedTextProps & RefAttributes<HTMLElement>): ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | null
```

#### Parameters

- `props`: Native text attributes, presentation options and owned content.

#### Returns

A semantic text root, including when children render nothing.

#### Return shape

#### FormattedText return branch 1

```ts
null
```

#### FormattedText return branch 2

```ts
ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>
```

## FormattedTextProps

Native text attributes plus bounded inline Markdown and toolkit typography.
A Fluent theme supplies CSS variables; no SPFx provider is required.
Group mixed Markdown strings and JSX actions with `React.Fragment`; strings inside other
JSX elements, including `<span>`, remain literal.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { FormattedTextProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { FormattedTextProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { FormattedTextProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/formatted-text';
```

### Examples (2)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { FormattedText } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<FormattedText as="h2" variant="title2" maxLines={2}>Read the **updates**.</FormattedText>
```

### Type

```ts
interface FormattedTextProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "dangerouslySetInnerHTML" | "color" | "children">
```

### Members

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FormattedTextProps.align` | `"justify" \| "center" \| "end" \| "start" \| undefined` | Optional | 'start' | Text alignment, default start; start/end follow writing direction.<br>When omitted, defaults to start. |
| `FormattedTextProps.as` | `FormattedTextSemanticElement \| undefined` | Optional | 'span' | HTML root, default span. Does not depend on variant; natural display follows this element.<br>When omitted, defaults to span. |
| `FormattedTextProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional | — | Owned strings, arrays and `React.Fragment` receive Markdown when enabled. Use a fragment<br>to group mixed strings and JSX actions. Other JSX elements, including `<span>`, retain their<br>identity, props, refs and contents; their descendants are not parsed. Markdown limits and<br>complete literal fallback apply separately to each owned string, as described by markdown.<br>When omitted, the semantic text root has no content. |
| `FormattedTextProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Not supported: children are the sole content pathway, and raw Markdown HTML is literal text.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `FormattedTextProps.font` | `"base" \| "numeric" \| "monospace" \| undefined` | Optional | 'base' | Fluent font family, default base. Numeric selects a family, not number formatting.<br>When omitted, defaults to base. |
| `FormattedTextProps.highlight` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | false | Wrap resolved content in a semantic mark, default false.<br>When omitted, defaults to false. |
| `FormattedTextProps.italic` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | false | Italic presentation, default false.<br>When omitted, defaults to false. |
| `FormattedTextProps.markdown` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | true | Parse owned strings, including arrays and `React.Fragment`, as safe inline Markdown; defaults<br>to `true`. Other JSX elements keep their children unchanged: `<span>{'**text**'}</span>`<br>stays literal even when enabled. Use a fragment to group Markdown strings and JSX actions.<br>Supported emphasis, code and links do not enable raw HTML or block Markdown; unsafe links<br>retain their text. Each owned string above 64 KiB UTF-8 falls back literally before parsing.<br>More than 2,000 original AST nodes or depth above 32 (root depth 1) also returns that entire<br>string literally. Node/depth checks occur after parsing and do not bound the parser's work.<br>See the FormattedText guide's Markdown and mixed JSX section for the full grammar and limits.<br>When omitted, inline Markdown parsing is enabled. |
| `FormattedTextProps.maxLines` | `number \| undefined` | Optional | — | Positive finite integer line limit. Applies block clamp layout even to span without changing its tag.<br>When omitted, adds no line clamp. Invalid values are ignored; takes precedence over truncate/wrap. Consumer style may override it. |
| `FormattedTextProps.strikethrough` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | false | Strike-through presentation, default false; composes with underline.<br>When omitted, defaults to false. |
| `FormattedTextProps.subtle` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | false | Apply the toolkit foreground.subtle descriptor, default false.<br>When omitted, defaults to false. |
| `FormattedTextProps.truncate` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | false | Request single-line ellipsis, default false; requires constrained width and suitable layout.<br>When omitted, defaults to false. |
| `FormattedTextProps.underline` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | false | Underline presentation, default false; composes with strikethrough.<br>When omitted, defaults to false. |
| `FormattedTextProps.variant` | `"display" \| "body1" \| "body1Strong" \| "body1Stronger" \| "body2" \| "caption1" \| "caption1Strong" \| "caption1Stronger" \| "caption2" \| "caption2Strong" \| "subtitle1" \| "subtitle2" \| "subtitle2Stronger" \| "title1" \| "title2" \| "title3" \| "largeTitle" \| undefined` | Optional | 'body1' | Existing typography recipe, default body1. Does not select an HTML element.<br>When omitted, defaults to body1. |
| `FormattedTextProps.wrap` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | true | Permit normal wrapping, default true; overridden by truncate or valid maxLines.<br>When omitted, defaults to true. |
